newsitem.title: USA: National Service sees Q2 sale cutting EPS.
newsitem.headline: National Service sees Q2 sale cutting EPS.

text.p: National Service Industries said on Wednesday it expected the sale of its insulation business in the second quarter to slightly reduce its full year fiscal 1997 earnings.

The company said immediate returns of the reinvested proceeds would not be able to offset the operating profits of that business. It signed a letter of intent with Performance Contracting Group to the insulation business at a price slightly over book value, National Service said.
Sales for this segment were $27 million and operating profits increased to $1.6 million due to lower material and operating costs, the company said.
